    Settings

    Pick any board and use it in any theme — the theme keeps its own colours, screens and coach, only the squares change. Theme board is the board your theme normally uses.
    Board texture — when you pick a different board
    Keep theme texture: the picked board's colours show, and your theme's pattern stays over them — the Jungle leaves and paw prints, the Vines flowers, the Bamboo weave. Full board: the board you picked comes complete with its own texture, exactly as it looks in its own theme, and the theme's pattern goes.

    For this theme only — slide and the board changes at once.

    These sliders change only the chess boards, and only for the theme you are using now. Every theme keeps its own setting on this device until you change it.
    Hear each sound — Click, Move, Check all different
    These buttons play the sound you picked above, one event at a time — tap them and hear that the click, the move, the capture, check and checkmate are all different sounds, never the same one twice.
    Every theme can have its own sound. Tap a theme below, then tap the sound you want for it. That sound stays saved for that theme on this device until you change it — switch themes and each one plays the sound you gave it.
    Sound for this theme — tap one to set it
    Volume — set it yourself, up to full
    The slider is saved on this device and stays after a reload. Move sounds at 100 play at full volume — boosted louder than Chaturanga used to be.
    Both bots play at this Elo for real — Stockfish is limited to it, so Elo 1800 plays like 1800, not like a full-strength engine.
    Move effect
    Pieces always glide — one smooth slide, and longer moves take a little longer. The effect is the decoration that plays while the piece travels. Grass: little leaves fly off both squares. Bubbles: bubbles rise off both squares. Hit: an impact burst where the piece lands — bigger when it captures. Sparkle: stars twinkle over both squares. Petals: pink petals scatter off both squares. Theme default: Grass in Green, Jungle and Vines, Bubbles in Marine, Sparkle in the Space themes, Petals in Cherry and Lavender, Hit on every other board. Any effect works in any theme.
    Speed
    How fast pieces move when they move, on puzzles and in Play. Off makes every move instant.
    Coach speech — bubbles or one text box, in any theme
    Bubbles: every coach line is its own speech cloud, like the Marine theme. Text box: all the lines sit in one box, like the other themes. Theme default keeps what your theme already does — Marine, Space and Space 2 use bubbles, the rest use the text box.
    Play screen buttons — compact row or the full set, in any theme
    Compact: one row only — Options, Resign, Hint, Undo — with everything else under Options, like the Marine, Space and Space 2 themes. Full: the Auto hint and Engine switches, the New game button and every button in two rows, like the other themes.
    Coach & alien size
    Slide to make your coach bigger or smaller next to the board — the portrait coaches, the Space aliens, Marine's octopus and Jungle's Moss all follow it, in Play and in puzzles. Saved on this device.
    Stockfish is loading…
    Stockfish runs free inside this page. It judges moves and powers the Best move hint; if it cannot load, the coach’s own check gives the marks instead.
    Movement sound — one sound in every theme
    The sound a moving piece makes. Pick one and it plays in every theme, on both boards, saved on this device until you change it. Only the real packs are here — Chess.com, Lichess, Grasses (real grass recordings, free CC0) and Chess.com Nature. "Each theme its own sound" hands the choice back to the themes and the Sound settings.
    Your data lives only on this device — a backup file is the way to keep it safe or move it to another phone.

    Board, sound, move sound style, the movement sound and the sound you picked for each theme, coach and pieces apply to both the puzzle board and the Bot board at once, and they stay saved on this device after you reload the page — until you change them.

    Choose your coach

    Tap a coach to play a game with them.

    Tap a coach card to start a game with that coach. You can also change your coach any time in Settings.
